rationale: Integration tests fail due to incorrect httpx.AsyncClient usage pattern, blocking 'Unit/integration tests with passing results' acceptance criterion. Missing http:// and file:// integration tests leave URI scheme coverage incomplete. Five edge cases identified: unhandled ValueError (returns 500 instead of 400), case-sensitive scheme matching (rejects valid uppercase URIs), missing uri parameter not validated, type coercion masks errors, whitespace-only URIs pass validation.

business_review.criterion: Service invokes `convert_to_markdown(uri)` for all URI schemes
business_review.notes: Integration tests verify https:// and data: schemes. Unit tests verify all four schemes pass validation. Missing: end-to-end integration tests for http:// and file:// schemes.

business_review.criterion: Conversion output validated and returned to client
business_review.notes: Integration tests verify response structure with 'content' field, markdown format validation, and HTTP 200 status.

business_review.criterion: Error handling for invalid URIs or conversion failures
business_review.notes: URI validation layer integrated into methods.py:92-94. Error handling tests cover invalid URI schemes and empty URIs.

Unit tests pass (12 tests). Integration tests fail immediately: AsyncClient initialization uses incorrect pattern `AsyncClient(app=app, base_url=...)` instead of `httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url=...)`
README.md lines 135-176: New 'Using markitdown-mcp' section with URI schemes, usage example, and error handling documentation.

findings.problem: Integration tests use incorrect httpx.AsyncClient initialization pattern causing all tests to fail
findings.impact: Acceptance criterion 'Unit/integration tests with passing results' is not satisfied - integration tests fail immediately on client initialization with TypeError: AsyncClient.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'app'
findings.recommendation: Replace `AsyncClient(app=app, base_url='http://test')` with either: (1) use the async_client fixture from conftest.py, or (2) use the correct pattern: `httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app), base_url='http://test')`. Pattern is shown in tests/conftest.py:32-37.

findings.problem: Missing end-to-end integration tests for http:// and file:// URI schemes
findings.impact: Acceptance criterion 'Service invokes convert_to_markdown(uri) for all URI schemes' is only partially satisfied - only https:// and data: schemes have end-to-end integration tests
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests test_convert_to_markdown_http_uri() and test_convert_to_markdown_file_uri() to verify end-to-end conversion for all four supported URI schemes as specified in spec lines 122-123.

findings.problem: ValueError from validate_uri is not caught, propagates as unhandled exception returning HTTP 500 instead of 400 Bad Request
findings.impact: Invalid URIs return HTTP 500 with generic 'MCP method execution failed' message instead of HTTP 400 with the clear validation error message from validate_uri ('URI cannot be empty', 'Invalid URI scheme...')
findings.recommendation: Wrap validate_uri call in try/except ValueError and raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=...) with structured error, OR add ValueError to the exception handlers in routes.py _handle_single_usage_request and _handle_cached_client_request to convert it to 400 Bad Request

findings.problem: Case-sensitive scheme matching fails for uppercase schemes like 'HTTP://example.com' or 'HTTPS://example.com'
findings.impact: Valid URIs with uppercase schemes are rejected with 'Invalid URI scheme' error, even though HTTP RFCs treat scheme as case-insensitive
findings.recommendation: Add .lower() to uri before scheme checks: uri_lower = uri.lower(); has_valid_scheme = any(uri_lower.startswith(scheme) for scheme in VALID_SCHEMES)

findings.problem: Type coercion of non-string uri to str() may hide underlying type issues - str(None) becomes 'None' string, str([]) becomes '[]'
findings.impact: Type errors are masked - str(None) becomes 'None' string which fails validation with 'Invalid URI scheme' instead of indicating a missing/null parameter. Confusing error messages for users passing wrong types.
findings.recommendation: Check type before str() cast: if not isinstance(clean_arguments['uri'], str): raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail={'error': 'uri parameter must be a string'})

findings.problem: Validation only runs if 'uri' key exists in clean_arguments - missing uri parameter is not caught client-side
findings.impact: convert_to_markdown called without required uri parameter fails with downstream markitdown-mcp server error instead of clear client-side validation. Should fail fast with clear message.
findings.recommendation: Check for uri presence explicitly: if name == 'convert_to_markdown': if 'uri' not in clean_arguments: raise HTTPException(400, detail='convert_to_markdown requires uri parameter'); validate_uri(str(clean_arguments['uri']))

findings.problem: Strip on content_after_scheme can hide malformed URIs with only whitespace like 'http://   '
findings.impact: Malformed whitespace-only URIs pass validation and get sent to markitdown-mcp, which may fail with obscure downstream errors instead of clear validation rejection
findings.recommendation: Check before strip: if not uri[len(scheme):] or not uri[len(scheme):].strip() - to distinguish between truly empty vs whitespace-only
